notes:
• V.S. Wakankar discovered the Bhimbetka rock caves in Madhya Pradesh (while traveling from Itarsi to Bhopal).
  • Alexander Carlyle discovered the first rock paintings in India at Suhagighat, UP in 1886-1887.
  • Justice R.M. Dere took oath as the first woman Chief Justice of the Meghalaya High Court.
  • Kerala Government renamed the Aralam Wildlife Sanctuary (Kannur district) to Aralam Butterfly Sanctuary.
  • Dugong (Sea Cow) is primarily found in the Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve (Tamil Nadu) and is protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.
  • Jharkhand implemented the PESA (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act.
